exposure: lack of skilled attendant at birth
Five hierarchical blocks of increasing proximity to the outcomes: household, maternal, health systems, child, and early feeding characteristics
cohort: 6592 women with young children for the EIBF analysis and 1512 women with young children for the EBF analysis
finding: Modifiable risk factors associated with suboptimal breastfeeding practices in Colombia included C-section, lack of skilled attendant at birth, prelacteal feeding, maternal nutritional status, and pregnancy intention.
mod_finding: C-section was associated with both delayed breastfeeding initiation and interruption of exclusive breastfeeding.
followup_time: <24 months for EIBF and <6 months for EBF
